item.title: Troubleshooting a Windows Device Not Appearing in Microsoft Intune
item.description:
Root Cause

The device was Microsoft Entra registered, but it had not completed Microsoft Intune MDM enrolment. The device status showed MDM: None, and dsregcmd /status showed AzureAdJoined: NO and WorkplaceJoined: YES.

The work or school account connection needed to be re-established after confirming that the user had a valid Intune licence and was included in the MDM user scope.

Objective

The goal of this lab was to enrol a Windows 10 device into Microsoft Intune and associate it with the correct user.
